titlestmt.titleproper: A Guide to the Frederick Scoff papers FA270

profiledesc.creation: This finding aid was produced using ArchivesSpace on 2026-10-18 10:54:32 UTC.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged materials are available at the discretion of RAC.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: Donated to Rockefeller Archive Center by Frederick Schoff, October 2009.
Records were received by RAC as Accession 2009:094.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Processing Level 0 - File-Level Access.
Records remain in original housing. Additional processing will be conducted in the future to improve description, enhance access, and long-term preservation.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: Rockefeller Archive Center has title, copyright and literary rights in the collection, in so far as it holds them, and has authority to grant permission to cite and publish archival material from the collection.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Loosely arranged in series by subject/topic.

bioghist.head: Biographical / Historical
bioghist.p: Frederick Schoff served as an Executive Vice President of the Foundation Center, focusing primarily on information resources and publishing.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The Frederick Schoff papers document his work with the Foundation Center including strategic and program planning documents, meeting records, workshops, project planning and development, information services and publications, collaborative efforts, as well as finances, funding records, and documentation of capital campaigns.
